headline: Policies on harassment, hazing, and bullying and on employee-student electronic communication, plus a Ford F550 bid and payments over $50K.
summary: The agenda includes a closed executive session and first readings of two policies. It also covers an ends policy update, a merger committee appointment, the Superintendent's report, and consent agenda items such as payments and a vehicle bid.
items: Closed executive session on employment, attorney-client communication, labor negotiations, and real estate
Monthly 2.4 Financial Condition and Activities Review
Policy F4 The Prevention of Harassment, Hazing, and Bullying of Students (first reading)
Policy D9 Electronic Communications Between Employees and Students (first reading)
Designate third board member for Act 170 Merger Committee
Superintendent's Report: SouthPoint move, Strategic Plan, Budget Progress
Consent agenda: accounts payable orders over $50K, A/P voucher checks, payroll warrants, Ford F550 Super Duty (Campus Salting Vehicle) bid, and setting the October 21, 2026 agenda
Review future agenda items and parking lot
